class.name: IfcFillAreaStyle
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The style for filling visible curve segments, annotation fill areas or surfaces with tiles or hatches. An IfcFillAreaStyle provides the style table for presentation information assigned to annotation fill areas or surfaces for hatching and tiling. The IfcFillAreaStyle defines hatches as model hatches, that is, the distance between hatch lines, or the curve pa

members.member: The set of fill area styles to use in presenting visible curve segments, annotation fill areas or surfaces. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.
In IFC4 files, this is the [code]ModelorDraughting[/code] attribute. A bool, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
